authzservice-improve-authz-caching-grafa.reason: On main today pkg/services/authz/rbac/cache.go userPermDenialCacheKey still ends with + "_" + name + "_" + parent; the action segment now goes through permCacheActionPart (action + "!" + digest), but name and parent are still joined with bare underscores, so (name=a_b,parent=c) and (name=a,parent=b_c) still collide. Check() in service.go still returns deny on any denial-cache hit for that key.

The test 'Should deny on explicit cache deny entry' still exists on main in service_test.go with the comment 'Allow access to the dashboard to prove this is not checked' and still seeds permCache with map[string]bool{"dashboards:uid:dash1": false}, so it would pass without the denial-cache branch.

On main, Check() still falls through to getIdentityPermissions whenever the cached permission map does not allow, and getUserPermissions has no permCache lookup (only singleflight then a DB query and permCache.Set); the denial cache is still keyed per resource name/parent, so each distinct denied resource still triggers a full permission reload.
